description: Defines the EventLoop class and related structures for handling asynchronous event dispatching, including registration, removal, and handling of events via callbacks.

classes.name: EventLoop
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for an event-driven loop, including registration/removal of event handlers and running the loop.

methods.name: register_handlers
methods.description: Registers a set of event handlers for a specific file descriptor.

methods.name: remove_handlers
methods.description: Removes previously registered event handlers for a specific file descriptor.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a single iteration of the event loop, processing IO events.

methods.name: set_handler_name
methods.description: Sets a human-readable name for a registered event handler.
